description: Identify and list the top 5 countries with the largest freshwater reserves, including the percentage of the world's total freshwater they hold
Analyze the current global water consumption trends, including the average daily per capita water usage in urban and rural areas
Research and document the 3 most significant water-related diseases affecting human populations worldwide, including their causes, symptoms, and prevention methods
Investigate and compare the energy requirements for different water treatment technologies, including reverse osmosis, distillation, and ultraviolet (UV) treatment
Examine the projected impacts of climate change on global water resources by 2050, including changes in precipitation patterns, sea-level rise, and increased frequency of extreme weather events
